Marta (CS): FYI — Aurora Reco just pinged us. They dropped a usage preview: currently ~220 qps on the hosted API but product is spinning up 5 new creative squads next sprint, estimate ~1.2k qps within 4–6 weeks. asking about burst handling and onboarding timeline. :eyes:
Jamal (SE): Thanks Marta. Any SLA or data residency asks? Is this mostly embeddings or generation?
Marta (CS): It's mixed — realtime recommendations (generation) + nightly batch embeddings for indexing. No strict residency but they prefer EU region traffic stay in EU. Mentioned 99.9% availability target for production.
Liam (Solutions): Sounds like a good Dedicated pilot candidate. Quick sketch: reserve a 2-GPU pool in eu-west, enable autoscale with a 4x burst buffer, set prefix caching for frequently requested sessions. Estimated committed qps headroom ~1.5k.
Keiko (Account): I'll flag as an expansion opportunity for renewal play. They're on a monthly hosted plan now; we should propose a 6-mo Dedicated pilot + enablement package. Can we also capture a short readiness checklist for CS enablement?
Jamal (SE): Checklist draft: 1) model variant selection + quantization guidance, 2) routing policy for eu vs global, 3) KV/prefix cache tuning, 4) SLO runbook and fallback model mapping, 5) onboarding runbook for squads. I'll paste a small config snippet for traffic shaping:
```
route_policy:
  - region: eu-west
    capacity: dedicated
    min_instances: 2
    burst_multiplier: 4
cache:
  enabled: true
  prefix_ttl: 1800
```
Marta (CS): Nice. Also capture training data access notes — they might want private VPC for batch jobs later. Add "private eval cluster" as an optional ask.
infra-bot: New ticket created: CS-4729 "Aurora Reco — Dedicated pilot scoping" assigned to Jamal, Liam. Link: https://internal/CS-4729
Keiko (Account): I'll schedule a scoping call with their PM + infra lead for Tues 10am PT. @Liam @Jamal please confirm availability.
Liam (Solutions): Confirmed. I'll bring model/quantization recommendations and estimated cost delta.
Jamal (SE): Confirmed. I'll prepare a sample canary plan and fallback mapping.
Marta (CS): Great — next steps: 1) scoping call, 2) draft pilot quote (Keiko), 3) Dedicated config & runbook (Jamal/Liam), 4) enablement slot for 5 squads (CS). I'll update CS-4729 after the call. :thumbsup:
